title: fix(voc): survey preview scroll-to-error on blocked submit (PROJ-2092)
summary: Preview blocks an unanswered required question, scrolls the first erroring card into view, highlights it, then submits successfully after the answer is supplied.

acceptance_cases.title: Blocked submit scrolls to and highlights the first unanswered required question
A later invalid question is not selected before the first invalid question
Answering the required question clears the error and reaches completion
